registration.title: Skill scores pulled down by level, released in the player ratings
registration.what: Production's skill scores take MC-0033 at the owner's setting: one way, 0.75 standard deviations per 100 points of club strength below the reference leagues' average, on top of MC-0032's league offsets. The ranks are unchanged.
registration.why: The owner's judgement, 2026-10-22, that lower-league output should count for less in the skill scores than the movers' data alone says.
registration.how: SKILL_LEVEL_PULL = 0.75, one way, in player_ratings.py (experiments/skill_level/DESIGN.md, amendment 1): one new player-model version.
registration.hypothesis: None to test: a judgement. Every rank stays as it was.
registration.success_criteria: No live test: nothing is predicted from the skill scores. The ranks must stay identical (checked by experiments/skill_level/report.py).
